recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中一小群大型母細胞，細胞質中等量、灰藍色並散佈細小嗜天青顆粒，核圓或輕微凹陷、染色質細緻並見核仁，呈單核球系母細胞（monoblast/promonocyte）樣，符合 AML with t(9;11) 常見的單核球分化。
features: Cluster of large blasts with moderate amounts of gray-blue cytoplasm
Fine azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Round to slightly indented or notched nuclei with fine, lacy chromatin and visible nucleoli
One cell with a folded/bilobed nucleus and pinkish granular cytoplasm, likely a maturing myelomonocytic cell
Background red cells without specific abnormality
describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large blasts with moderate amounts of gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules. The nuclei are round to slightly indented with finely dispersed chromatin and one or more nucleoli, and one adjacent cell has a folded nucleus with pinkish granular cytoplasm consistent with a maturing myelomonocytic element. No Auer rods are identified. The monocytoid blast morphology is consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation, which in this case carries t(9;11)(p22;q23); KMT2A-MLLT3; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry help confirm the monocytic lineage.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have less abundant, less gray cytoplasm, may contain Auer rods, and are nonspecific esterase-negative with a maturing neutrophil series.
Promyelocytes in APL are packed with coarse granules, may have multiple Auer rods (faggot cells) and bilobed nuclei, and are CD34-/HLA-DR-.
Mature monocytes have condensed, folded chromatin without nucleoli and vacuolated cytoplasm, and blasts are not increased.
